notable.note: colonial-era legacy language, largely faded from everyday use but reintroduced as an elective school subject since the 2020s

terrainDescription.zh: 全境約九成為撒哈拉沙漠，人口幾乎全數集中在狹窄的地中海沿岸地帶。
terrainDescription.en: Roughly 90% of the country is Sahara desert, with nearly the entire population concentrated along a narrow Mediterranean coastal strip.

historicalContext.zh: 阿拉伯語為官方語言，義大利語曾因殖民歷史在都市地區留下影響，但日常使用已大幅減少；境內另有塔馬哈克、納富西等柏柏爾語族的少數語言社群。
historicalContext.en: Arabic is the official language; Italian left a historical linguistic mark in urban areas from the colonial era, though everyday use has faded considerably. Minority Berber-language communities (Tamahaq, Nafusi, and others) also exist within the country.
